svg.title: Acoustic end-to-end pipeline v2.6
svg.desc: Four dataset-native lanes feed the current adjustable shared-window benchmark policy, one selected frozen candidate encoder, a shared projector, and dataset-native heads. Engineering readiness and performance evidence are separated.

text.tspan: Patients 156 and 218 occur in both partitions
Native units: respiratory event · whole recording
Recording: Normal · CAS · DAS · CAS & DAS
Inter: unseen patients · Intra: repeated patients
Inter and intra are evaluated separately
No raw Normal/Negative · gaps are not negative
Native unit: whole recording · raw sound type
Labels: N · E W · I E W · C · I C · I C E W
No official split · diagnosis is a separate target
no label mapping at this stage
BEATs p symbolic · HeAR internals not exposed
ICBHI: exact Normal / Crackle / Wheeze / Both
HF: positive intervals only; gaps masked
KAUH: defined subset; Crep/Bronchial/I C B HOLD
Unknown is a mask state, not a learned class
Other opens only for explicit eligible labels
Unknown = mask state · no Unknown logit
event and recording remain separate tasks
never collapsed into one native score
accuracy is not the only criterion
